inspo: Ryomen Sukuna: Heian-era lore, the Hida legend, Uraume, Kamutoke, Mahoraga and Agito, Reverse Cursed Technique, Domain Amplification, the vows with Yuji
desc: Descended from the King of Curses: four arms, two faces, a twin devoured before birth, and an appetite for everything. In the Hida legend he is a hero who slew a dragon; in the Heian era every sorcerer alive failed to kill him. These abilities avoid the Master Chef's kit (no slashes, domain or fire arrows).

effects.name: Four Arms
effects.text: Your offhand works as a full main hand for tools and weapons.

effects.name: Second Face
effects.text: Mobs behind you within 8 blocks glow: the face on the back of your head is watching.

effects.name: Devoured Twin
effects.text: +4 max health: you absorbed your twin in the womb.

effects.name: Gluttony
effects.text: Eat raw and rotten food safely, and all food gives 20% more.

effects.name: King's Presence
effects.text: Mobs with less than half your max health won't approach unless you attack them.

effects.name: Reverse Flow
effects.text: Natural regeneration is 50% faster.

effects.name: Regrowth
effects.text: A hit of 6 or more damage heals back 25% of itself over 3 s (once a minute).

effects.name: Contempt
effects.text: Slowness and Weakness last half as long on you.

effects.name: Heian Body
effects.text: +2 armour toughness.

effects.name: Mouth on the Palm
effects.text: Eating and drinking take half as long.

effects.name: Calamity
effects.text: +5% damage for each enemy within 8 blocks, up to 20%.

effects.name: Feared by Curses
effects.text: Undead deal 10% less damage to you.

effects.name: Dragon Slayer
effects.text: +15% damage to bosses and dragons, after the Hida legend of the dragon on Mount Kurai.

effects.name: Temple Founder
effects.text: Villagers honour you as a protector: trades cost 10% less.

effects.name: Heian Reflexes
effects.text: +10% attack speed.

effects.name: Arrogance
effects.text: At full health, +10% damage.

effects.name: Vow Keeper
effects.text: Once every 30 minutes, a fatal hit leaves you at 1 health.

effects.name: Unbowed
effects.text: Immune to knockback while sneaking.

effects.name: Unbreakable Remains
effects.text: Explosions deal 30% less damage to you.

effects.name: Patient Curse
effects.text: Hunger drains 25% slower.

effects.name: Black Flash Instinct
effects.text: Critical hits deal 15% more.

effects.name: Scent of Blood
effects.text: Creatures below half health within 16 blocks glow.

effects.name: Uraume's Favour
effects.text: Immune to freezing; ice and snow never slow you.

effects.name: Kamutoke's Owner
effects.text: Immune to lightning damage.

abilities.name: Take Over
abilities.text: The vow with the vessel: for 60 s, +20% damage and speed, but you can't use items; then Weakness I for 10 s. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
abilities.text: Heal 10 health over 2 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Mend Another
abilities.text: Heal the ally you touch for 8 and clear their harmful effects. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Palm Mouth
abilities.text: A mouth opens on your hand and eats the item stack you hold, giving 1 food per item (up to 10). 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Domain Amplification
abilities.text: For 5 s, spells and ability effects aimed at you fizzle. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Call Uraume
abilities.text: An ice servant follows you for 30 s, freezing water ahead and slowing enemies within 6 blocks. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Icefall
abilities.text: Raise a wall of ice 5 wide and 3 tall for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Agito
abilities.text: Summon Agito, which heals you 1 a second while you fight, for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Mahoraga's Wheel
abilities.text: Adapt to the last damage type that hit you: take 50% less from it for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Four-Armed Guard
abilities.text: Two arms guard while two strike: Resistance II for 4 s, and you can still attack. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Two-Faced Watch
abilities.text: Look both ways: every mob within 24 blocks glows for 15 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: King's Command
abilities.text: Hostile mobs below 20 health within 12 blocks flee from you for 6 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Heian Hunt
abilities.text: Mark a creature: see it through walls and its health for 2 minutes. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Mount Kurai Stride
abilities.text: Walk up blocks like stairs (+1 step height) and take no fall damage for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Temple Bell
abilities.text: Ring a bell: allies within 12 get Regeneration I and Resistance I for 8 s, and undead freeze for 1 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Twin's Share
abilities.text: Steal one beneficial effect from the creature you look at. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Puppet Host
abilities.text: Take over the mob you look at (below 30 health) and have it fight for you for 15 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reinforcement
abilities.text: Strength I and Resistance I for 15 s, costing 2 mana a second. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Worship
abilities.text: Villagers within 16 blocks bring you an offering of food, once per day.

abilities.name: Mocking Laugh
abilities.text: Enemies within 10 blocks turn on you but deal 15% less to you for 6 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Kamutoke
abilities.text: Draw the lightning bow and loose a bolt on the spot you look at (24 blocks) for 10 damage. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Know Your Place
abilities.text: The mob you look at is forced to kneel: stunned for 2 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.text: Eat a mob below 10% health outright, healing 6. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Heart Taker
abilities.text: Your next unarmed hit tears at the target: 6 damage, Weakness II for 6 s, and you heal 4. 60 s cooldown.
